in_sanskrit.name: Kriti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Creation, Performance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kriti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'kriti', which means creation, or the performance of an act. This name is often given to a child who is expected to excel in the arts or show great intelligence and creativity.

in_hindi.name: कृति
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kriti in Hindi is derived from the Tamil language, and it means 'creation' or 'composition'. It is pronounced as 'कृति' (kṛti).

in_tamil.name: க்ரிதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Kriti in Tamil means 'creation' or 'composition'. It is derived from the Tamil verb 'kritiyathu' which means 'to create' or 'to compose'.

in_telugu.name: కృది
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Kriti in Telugu means 'creation' or 'composition'. It is derived from the Telugu verb 'kriti' which means 'to create' or 'to compose'.
